author: TeIq
content: Implemented. Labels panel redesigned: groups by issuing labeler (one <details> per src DID), each summary shows display-name + @handle + count badge. Filter input at top narrows visible labels by val substring (case-insensitive); rows use hidden attribute so collapse state survives filter. Auto-collapse when total > 10 labels; auto-expand below. All BEM classes added to CSS with tokens-only colors. styles_coverage + styles_tokens tests pass; 158 lib tests pass.
